name: South Africa
description: South Africa from the Cradle of Humankind to the Zulu kingdom, colonial rule, diamonds and gold, apartheid, Mandela and democracy.

checkpoints.name: The first people
checkpoints.note: Some of the earliest human ancestors lived here. San hunters painted rocks, and Bantu farmers built kingdoms such as Mapungubwe.

checkpoints.name: Colony
checkpoints.note: The Dutch founded Cape Town in 1652. Britain took the Cape, the Zulu rose under Shaka, and diamonds and gold brought war and wealth.

checkpoints.name: Apartheid
checkpoints.note: The National Party made apartheid law in 1948. Resistance grew through Sharpeville and Soweto, and Mandela was jailed on Robben Island.

checkpoints.name: Democracy
checkpoints.note: Mandela walked free in 1990 and was elected president in 1994. The country hosted the World Cup in 2010.
